=== indent after colon
--- before
key:¦
--- keys
<enter>child: 1
--- after
key:
    child: 1¦

=== keep indent
--- before
a:
  b: 1¦
--- keys
<enter>c: 2
--- after
a:
  b: 1
  c: 2¦

=== flow mapping
--- before
a: ¦
--- keys
{x: 1
--- after
a: {x: 1¦}

=== flow sequence
--- before
a: ¦
--- keys
[1, 2
--- after
a: [1, 2¦]

=== quote
--- before
a: ¦
--- keys
"v
--- after
a: "v¦"

=== comment toggle
--- before
«a: 1
b: 2»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«# a: 1
# b: 2»

=== comment off
--- before
«# a: 1
# b: 2»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«a: 1
b: 2»

=== no autoclose in comment
--- before
# ¦
--- keys
[
--- after
# [¦

=== list item
--- before
items:
  - a¦
--- keys
<enter>- b
--- after
items:
  - a
  - b¦

=== surround
--- before
a: «v»
--- keys
'
--- after
a: '«v»'
